arguments: Dereference of unvalidated primary input vector base before null/length checks
message.text: Dereference of unvalidated primary input vector base before null/length checks

properties.metisTriageReason: Verdict: the reported direct dereference exists in the hash interface, but the concrete caller initializes and length-checks the first input vector before dispatch, so the local unsafe order is guarded upstream only for this path. Evidence: tfm_crypto_call_srv rejects missing first input, reads exactly sizeof(iov), sets in_vec[0].base to a local iov and in_vec[0].len to sizeof(struct tfm_crypto_pack_iovec), then dispatcher checks that length before calling tfm_crypto_hash_interface, where iov->function_id is dereferenced. Gap: none.
properties.mitigation: Before assigning or using iov fields, validate in_vec itself if applicable, in_vec[0].base != NULL, and in_vec[0].len >= sizeof(struct tfm_crypto_pack_iovec) or the minimum required layout for all accessed fields. Return PSA_ERROR_PROGRAMMER_ERROR on malformed vectors.
properties.reasoning: The interface treats in_vec as a caller-provided PSA input vector and immediately dereferences in_vec[0].base via iov->function_id before validating that in_vec[0].base is non-NULL and that in_vec[0].len is at least sizeof(struct tfm_crypto_pack_iovec) or otherwise large enough to contain function_id and alg/op_handle fields used later. If a malformed caller message can reach this shim with a NULL, short, or invalid first vector, the secure partition may read outside the supplied message or fault before returning a PSA error. The source file does not show any prior validation of in_vec[0], so this is a privilege-boundary validation-order candidate.
